note: Hierarchical Term Formatter adds one field formatter (id hierarchical_term_formatter) for entity_reference fields targeting taxonomy_term. Settings: display (all|grouping|parents|root|nonroot|leaf), link (bool), wrap (none|span|div|ul|ol), separator (default ' » '), reverse (bool). No config UI, no permissions, no Drush. State lives only in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode> -> content.<field> with type: hierarchical_term_formatter. Medium/hard cases create a namespaced vocabulary + an entity_reference(taxonomy_term) field on Article and read/write that formatter on the default view display. Scripts obtain the view display via entity_display.repository->getViewDisplay() because node.article.default is not persisted on this minimal site.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site I want a taxonomy term reference field on a node to display as 'Parent » Child' instead of just the child term. Which contrib field formatter provides this, what is its formatter machine id, and on which kind of field is it available?
evals.expected_output: The Hierarchical Term Formatter module, formatter id hierarchical_term_formatter. It is available on entity_reference fields whose target type is taxonomy_term (isApplicable checks target_type == taxonomy_term).

evals.prompt: In the Hierarchical Term Formatter's settings, what are the choices for the 'Terms to display' option, and what is the default separator between terms?
evals.expected_output: display can be all, grouping, parents, root, nonroot, or leaf. The default separator setting is ' » ' (a space, right-pointing double angle quote, space).

evals.prompt: The Hierarchical Term Formatter has no admin configuration page. Where do you select it and where is that choice stored in Drupal configuration?
evals.expected_output: You select it on the entity bundle's Manage display page (per view mode). It is stored on the component in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>, with content.<field>.type: hierarchical_term_formatter and its settings (display, link, wrap, separator, reverse).

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a taxonomy term reference field field_htf_known whose display uses the Hierarchical Term Formatter. Inspect the live default view display and state which 'Terms to display' (display) option is configured for it.
evals.expected_output: display is 'parents': in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_htf_known component has type hierarchical_term_formatter with settings.display: parents.

evals.prompt: The Article field field_htf_sep on this site is displayed with the Hierarchical Term Formatter using a non-default separator. Inspect the live view-display configuration and report the exact separator string it uses.
evals.expected_output: The separator is ' / ' (space slash space): core.entity_view_display.node.article.default field_htf_sep component, type hierarchical_term_formatter, settings.separator: ' / '.

evals.prompt: On this site the Article content type has a taxonomy term reference field field_htf_cats. Configure the default view display so this field uses the Hierarchical Term Formatter (hierarchical_term_formatter) showing only the topmost/root term (the 'root' display option). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_htf_cats component has type hierarchical_term_formatter and settings.display: root.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has a taxonomy term reference field field_htf_path. Make it display the full term hierarchy (the term and all its parents) as clickable links, using ' > ' (space greater-than space) as the separator between terms, via the Hierarchical Term Formatter. Save it to the live default display.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_htf_path component has type hierarchical_term_formatter with settings.display: all, settings.link: true, and settings.separator: ' > '.
